plugin.description: Send messages to your Grok Bots and read their replies. With no bot named, sends to the default bot chosen in settings. Supports bot nicknames. Sign in in settings.

actions.name: send_to_agent
actions.description: Send the user’s message to one of their Grok Bots. Use when the user says "tell Grok Bot …" or names a bot or nickname (e.g. "send to work …"). chat_id is an instanceId from agent/chats, a nickname or a bot name; omit it to use the default bot chosen in settings. Returns a delivery receipt, not the bot's answer; use read_grok_bot later for its reply. Do not automatically retry an uncertain delivery.

message.description: The message to send to Grok Bot.

chat_id.description: The bot's instanceId from agent/chats, its nickname, or its name. Omit to use the default bot.

actions.name: read_grok_bot
actions.description: Read the latest replies from one of the user's Grok Bots, oldest first. chat_id is an instanceId from agent/chats, a nickname or a bot name; omit it to use the default bot chosen in settings.

limit.description: How many recent replies to return (1-20, default 3).

chat_id.description: The bot's instanceId from agent/chats, its nickname, or its name. Omit to use the default bot.
